title: Rezoning for 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves changing the zoning at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick from a manufacturing district to a mixed-use district (M1-2A/R6A, MX-22). The change would allow a new six-story mixed-use building with 18 apartments, including five permanently income-restricted units, and 6,000 square feet of ground floor commercial space. It is linked to a related zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the site.
